learning_outcomes.text: Student acquire knowledge about the criteria and methods for the proper use of tools, measuring equipment and devices for diagnostics, monitoring and automation of industrial mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of energetic concepts, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, and electrical engineering
Sizing of a pneumatic control valve.
Scheme of control of a mechanical plant
Mechanical plants controlled by two position
Industrial furnace: methane and gas supply line
assessment_rules: The final exam consists of a written and oral assessment. It aims to assess the learning of the design methodology of mechanical industrial plants, with particular attention to regulation and control systems, and the ability to define the main characteristics of control systems and instrumentation, and to apply concepts with P&ID and electromechanical panels. Calculators are permitted, but AI, smartphones, smartwatches, and tablets are prohibited; any use will lead to immediate invalidation and reporting.
